body.message:
As per your request, please find below the 2-month rates for a 1-bedroom apartment at Coral by Vision:

October: AED 11,500
November: AED 13,500

Please note that a security deposit of AED 2,000 is required.

The booking will be processed on a monthly basis (30 nights per month).

Please also note that the rate displayed online is applicable only for September. Rates may vary from month to month depending on availability and demand. The above rates are applicable to your requested dates.

To confirm and secure the booking, the first month’s rent, last month’s rent, and security deposit must be paid in advance. Once the payment is received, we will be able to reserve the unit and guarantee the agreed rate for the confirmed booking period.

Thank you, and please let us know if you would like to proceed.
